name: termux_build
params: src:string:源文件绝对路径|out:string:输出路径(可空)
cmd: sh /data/adb/lemon_kernel/lemon/dedup/run.sh termux_build export PREFIX=/data/data/com.termux/files/usr; export PATH=$PREFIX/bin:/system/bin; export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$PREFIX/lib; export TMPDIR=$PREFIX/tmp; export HOME=/data/data/com.termux/files/home; cd $HOME; o=$out; if [ -z "$o" ]; then o=$HOME/a.out; fi; clang -O2 -o "$o" $src && echo BUILD_OK && ls -l "$o"
